description: Delete an entire project by code — every case, suite, run, result, defect and milestone in it, with no trash to recover from; this cannot be undone. The most destructive call in the API; confirm the code with qase_project_context first. Asks the user for confirmation and does not proceed without it. Cost: one API call, about 0.5s.
name: qase_project_delete
title: Delete project
